objective: Prove the web-design runtime by rendering an intentionally weak local draft, feeding exact visual and engineering defects into one repair, and terminally re-rendering the resolved candidate.
value_signal: The design loop itself proves that critique changes the next build and that a synthetic review never promotes a candidate to production-ready.
source_evidence: Product, design, brief, authority, and implementation sources are hash-bound before planning and recollected at terminal verification.
finish_line: Every isolated surface preserves its source authority, resolves every recorded defect within the repair budget, passes all ten engineering and craft gates, reproduces from final candidate hashes, and remains local pending separate adoption or deployment authority.

governance.canonical_state: The source brief, product/design documents, high-craft factory concept, source project, and deployment state remain canonical and read only.
governance.rollback: Discard the isolated candidate and evidence directory; preserve the source project, mapped site, queue, and external systems unchanged.
governance.escalation: Return the exact unresolved craft or engineering defect, missing authority, source drift, exhausted repair budget, or approval boundary to Marketing Chief.
